# Krizaka

> Krizaka is a Montréal (Québec) open-source software studio. It forges the
> building blocks of its products — Krizaka UI (design system, web and native)
> and Krizaka Java (Spring Boot kit) — and ships seven products on them, each on
> its own page (coming soon). Every repository is public under Apache-2.0 at
> https://github.com/krizaka.

## Products (each has its own page, coming soon)

- Orazaka — sovereign, on-premise AI orchestration engine. Site: https://www.orazaka.com · source: https://github.com/krizaka/orazaka
- Yomizaka (in development) — your documents, read and checked by Orazaka. Site: https://www.yomizaka.com · source: https://github.com/krizaka/yomizaka
- Akinaza (in development) — bookings, invoices and a GST/QST ledger for independent Québec shops; it prepares tax returns, the merchant files them. Site: https://www.akinaza.com · source: https://github.com/krizaka/akinaza
